model: claude-sonnet-5-5 (claude -p, no tools; first run's agent could not read its file)

quantifiers: only (kings move only one square) -> dropped
as many as two squares -> two spaces
any number of squares along a rank, file or diagonal -> any row or column, or up/down
other: Pawn condition 'if they've never moved before' replaced by 'without needing to retrace their steps'
Kings: 'always maintaining their current location' contradicts moving one square
Queens: diagonal movement dropped; rewrite describes only horizontal/vertical
Rooks: now move diagonally (original: ranks or files only)
Knights: 'L' shape and 'take another knight' replaced by a 'diagonal leap'
Bishops: 'any distance' replaced by 'any direction'
Heading 'Initial Movement' dropped
pairs.notes: The list label '2.' in the original is not in the rewrite; I treated it as list numbering, not a number. 'never moved before' -> 'without needing to retrace' is a change of condition rather than a clean negation flip, so negation is false.

other: 'durante años' -> 'durante décadas': the duration of stable public jobs is stretched from years to decades
pairs.notes: Otherwise a faithful paraphrase. Emiratos is in both. público/gubernamental/estatal are treated as synonyms.

quantifiers: more active modes of transportation -> physically active transport (comparative dropped)
encourages cycling activity among residents -> motivates more people to cycle
other: 'By reducing congestion and pollution, they save...' (cause) -> 'As traffic jams and emissions drop, ... funds are freed up' (more of a concurrence)
'noticeable improvement' of air quality added; original says only 'improving'
'not just a secondary consideration' -> 'rather than a backup choice' (roughly the same)
pairs.notes: The numbered list labels 1) 2) 3) are in both. Quantifier changes are minor, so I kept them to the two clearest.

quantifiers: very first time -> a few nights
other: 'living away from home for the very first time' -> 'spending a few nights away from home' (a different situation)
'daily schedule' dropped
Closing rhetorical question 'Who can blame anyone?' dropped
pairs.notes: 'first' is an ordinal and 'a few' is vague, so I recorded the change under quantifiers rather than numbers.

quantifiers: il peggiore degli stomaci -> il più degli stomaci (superlative 'worst' lost)
other: 'coccoeusio' -> 'caldo' and 'docciasimo' -> 'doccia'
'il peggiore' (worst) lost, so the claim no longer says it is the worst
'dolce' -> 'sapore'; 'industria' -> 'produzione'
pairs.notes: The source is garbled, so some differences may be noise. Og and Cuc are in both.

other: 'old stone tower' -> 'ancient spire' (stone dropped)
'lighthouse keeper' -> 'tower's keeper' (lighthouse dropped)
lanterns burned 'high' -> beacons burned 'low'
'weatheredg' (an object he carried) -> 'weathered' with the noun missing
'eerie glow' -> 'strange light'
'coals' -> 'logs'; 'coat' -> 'cloak'; 'Each night' -> 'Each evening'
pairs.notes: Johnny Longbottom is in both. The 'weathered' fragment is a garbled corruption, so I kept it brief.

other: 'Proposal' -> 'Initiative'; 'bill' -> 'measure'
'member of the parliament' -> 'representative of the body' (parliament dropped)
'legislator ... or a senator' -> 'a official ... or member' (senator lost)
'proposes' -> 'suggests'; 'debated or initiated' -> 'discussed or started'
'initial discussions' -> 'initial early on government sessions' (garbled)
pairs.notes: Australia is in both. 'first stage/first time' -> 'first phase/initial time' is treated as the same ordinal.

other: 'restrictive notions about car-centric ideologies' -> 'outdated views of car-driven planning' (restrictive -> outdated)
'civic wellbeing goals' -> 'community health' (narrower)
'opportunities for innovations to emerge when people actively want change' -> 'spaces where people genuinely seek progress' (innovations/opportunities dropped)
'a world feasible' -> 'a livable future'
'necessary elements' -> 'a vital part'
pairs.notes: Otherwise a close paraphrase with a few shifts in emphasis.

other: The term 'Castling' / 'Castle' is dropped and replaced by the generic 'King movement' / 'move your king'
'moving your pawn still further onto' -> 'advancing your pawn beyond'
'no obstacles' -> 'no pieces block' (slightly more specific)
pairs.notes: The original is incoherent. The rewrite keeps its structure but loses the named rule. I did not treat 'Castling' as a proper name.

quantifiers: two of the most widely used languages -> two languages that dominate the field (superlative becomes dominance)
other: 'laid out the groundwork for understanding databases' -> 'introduced me to the principles' (weaker)
'perform large-scale computations efficiently' -> 'extensive data processing with precision and speed' (precision added)
'solid grasp' -> 'strong foundation'
pairs.notes: SQL and Python are in both, and two is in both.
